title: SIU clears officer
article: The Special Investigations Unit has cleared a Toronto police officer in the shooting death of Antonio Bellon.
Bellon, 63, was shot and killed Jan. 10 in an alleyway near 2021 Dufferin St. at Rogers Rd. after police responded to a complaint of threatening behaviour.
Constable Scott Ritchie fired three shots at Bellon after Bellon shot and wounded Sergeant Allen Jenkins.
Autopsy results showed that Bellon died of a single gunshot wound to the chest.
The SIU is an independent civilian agency that investigates incidents involving police and civilians that result in injury, sexual assault or death.
